atoms.text: Hi Jordan, could I ask you some questions about the football match today for the school newspaper?
Of course, Mohammed, I’d be happy to!
atoms.sound: Of course, Mohammed. I’d be happy to!

atoms.text: Today’s match against Oakmoor School looked tough. What were your expectations going into the game?
I knew that the game would be a real challenge. Oakmoor have been the strongest team all season, so the focus was on staying disciplined and not letting them control the game too easily.
atoms.sound: I knew that the game would be a real challenge. Oakmoor have been the strongest team all season. So the focus was on staying disciplined and not letting them control the game too easily.

atoms.text: The weather didn’t exactly help either — it was raining lots at kickoff! Did that affect your strategy?
We definitely had to rethink our original plan! The rain made the pitch heavy and unpredictable. We had to keep things simple, using short passes and avoiding unnecessary risks.

trainers.instruction: Match the word with the correct definition.

atoms.b: a strong belief about what will happen in the future
to behave in a controlled way
not easy to know what will happen next

atoms.text: Oakmoor managed to score first despite the awful weather. How did the team respond?
It was a tough moment. Going behind early against a team like that can shake your confidence, but I was pleased that we didn’t panic.
Then came that early injury. Your star player went down in the first five minutes. How big of a setback was that?
Huge! Losing your key player that early is never part of the plan. It forced us to rethink things immediately. I decided to bring Noor on to play.
Noor is new to the team this season. What made you bring her on?
I saw something in Noor during training. She had energy and a willingness to fight for every ball. In a game like today, that attitude can make all the difference.

atoms.text: Oakmoor scored the first goal of the match.
The star player got injured.
Noor was brought on to play.
Noor played a massive role in turning the game around. What impressed you most?
Courage. She came into a match with terrible weather and against a top team and still played with confidence.
Would you say Noor saved the team today?
I’d say Noor sparked something. Football is a team sport, but sometimes one player’s belief can change everything — and today, that was Noor.
There was a change in the weather too, wasn’t there?
That’s right. After Noor scored our first goal of the match, the sun came out and the rest of the game was played in glorious, sunny weather. We won the game 3-1.
atoms.sound: That’s right. After Noor scored our first goal of the match, the sun came out and the rest of the game was played in glorious, sunny weather. We won the game 3 1.

atoms.text: Final question: what does this result mean for the team going forward?
It shows we can compete with anyone. If we keep that resilience and team spirit, we’ll be tough to beat.
